name: Presence Versus Durable State Separation
description: Presence (cursors, online status, typing) is ephemeral. Durable state (documents, tasks) is persisted. The system must never confuse the two — different storage, different sync, different guarantees.
purpose: Clearly separate ephemeral presence data from durable persisted state so they use different storage, sync mechanisms, and guarantees — never confusing or conflating them.
acceptanceCriteria: Presence data (cursors, online status, typing indicators) is stored in a separate ephemeral key-value store, not the operation log.
Durable state (documents, tasks) is persisted in the operation log and local database.
Presence sync uses a separate, lower-overhead transport (e.g., WebSocket pub/sub).
Durable sync uses the operation log replay mechanism.
Presence data is never replayed during catch-up sync.
No code path allows presence data to leak into durable storage.
